verdict.rationale: Numeral offers an MCP server that lets AI agents query nexus status, filings, and other account data and answer natural-language questions (e.g., 'which states have I triggered nexus in') and lists 'AI product classification' as a feature, showing some AI-driven insight generation. However, this is framed as external agent tooling via MCP rather than native in-product AI-generated insights/suggestions surfaced directly in a Numeral dashboard UI. Missing for 10: evidence of a built-in AI insights/suggestions panel inside the product itself, proactive AI-generated recommendations beyond nexus alerts, and independent confirmation of AI classification quality.
